_meta.title: The Structured Mishnah
_meta.description: All 63 tractates of the Mishnah arranged as two-dimensional woven matrices. Each chapter is encoded as rows × columns, with cell labels marking structural position. Hebrew text manually transcribed from the Albeck edition by Moshe Kline; structural arrangement reflects 40 years of compositional analysis.
_meta.author: Moshe Kline
_meta.citation: Kline, Moshe. The Structured Mishnah. chaver.com.

schema.label_format: Row number followed by Hebrew column letter for differentiated cells (e.g., '2א'); row number alone for full-width cells (e.g., '5').
schema.structural_markers: Spans inside cells marking the woven structure: horizontal parallels, vertical threads, chiastic connections, envelope closures, and internal parallels. These are editorial and reflect compositional analysis.
schema.column_headers: Some chapters have conceptual column labels (e.g., 'אשה / עדות עצמית / עדות') stored in the column_headers field. These name the thematic axes of the chapter's two-dimensional layout.
schema.subdivisions: Some cells contain multiple subdivisions (A, B, C) marked by uppercase Latin letters. Each subdivision has its own text, mishnah number, and structural markers.

סמיכה ושחיטת צפון ומתן סביב
ותנופה והגשה
רבי יהודה אומר
אין מנחה בבמה
וכהון ובגדי שרת וכלי שרת וריח ניחוח
ומחצה בדמים ורחוץ ידים ורגלים
אבל הזמן והנותר והטמא שוים בזה ובזה
